notes.title: Millionaire Dancer updated to version beta 0.1.15
notes.content:
Features: 
  - Function that keeps selected music after music play.

 Changes: 
  - Show score and accuracy on the leaderboard.

 Bug fix: 
  - Problems with incorrect song leaderboard output when changing songs quickly.
  - The note was wrong on some musics.

Thank you!

notes.title: Beta 0.0.13 version will be updated in May.
notes.content:
Hello!
Here's what we've improved to make the game more fun.

1. As an early access plan, we will continue to increase the number of songs until release. In this May update, we will add a song 'Stereojazyy'.

2. Added game over function make you feel more difficult. Through this, you will struggle to become a Millionaire dancer.

Thank you!
